M-SHARD.NAME: Sharded indexes
M-SHARD.purpose: Define, read, validate and generate sharded module indexes so the repository map scales past the root index cap (ROADMAP ADR-6, G11).
M-SHARD.annotations: <fn-resolveShardPath PURPOSE="Resolve a against docs/ and prove it stays inside (no .., no absolute, .xml only)." />

CrossLink.relation: indexes are read by the shared filesystem layer
module list/find/index and module shard use this reader

contract.purpose: The root docs/graph-index.xml may replace flat module lines with <Shard href="modules/shard-<group>.xml" count="N" /> references; readers see the union exactly as if flat.

param.name: config
param.description: Optional effective config (shard cap = indexCaps.graph); type-only import.

param.name: loaded
param.description: entries, flatEntries, shards, findings, root header data.

error.description: Shard href is absolute, escapes docs/, contains NUL or is not .xml.
Referenced shard file does not exist.
Root reference count or shard-root count differs from actual entries.
Shard file root element is not ModuleShard.
A shard exceeds the configured index cap.

notes.note-1: Shards are index shards, not per-entity files: module show still reads docs/modules/M-XXX.xml directly.
notes.note-2: Generator: mygrace inspect module shard --group-by type|status|prefix; dry-run is the default, --apply writes atomically and keeps a timestamped backup under .mygrace/backups/.
notes.note-3: Re-running --apply on an already sharded project is a byte-identical no-op (idempotent), and stale shard-*.xml files are removed with a backup.
notes.note-4: No imports from grace-common on purpose so status/ci/test/packet/context can import this module without cycles.
